_readme: Category mapping for FEED 4 (Chicago Business Licenses - Current Active, Socrata uupf-x98q).
WHY THIS IS NOT A PURE license_description MAPPING:
The build spec asked for bucketing on license_description alone. Inspection of the
real data shows that is not achievable without asserting facts the data does not
support, for two measured reasons:
1. 23,007 of 54,023 rows (42.6%) carry 'Limited Business License' (16,360) or
'Regulated Business License' (7,647). These are administrative license TYPES.
They carry zero sector signal. Their sector lives only in business_activity.
2. 'Retail Food Establishment' (11,331 rows) is a single food-handling license that
covers grocery stores AND restaurants alike. Measured split via business_activity:
~3,896 'Retail Sales of Perishable Foods' vs ~2,434 'Preparation of Food and
Dining on Premises With Seating' vs ~1,610 'Sale of Food Prepared Onsite With
Dining Area'. Calling all 11,331 'restaurant_cafe' would mislabel every grocery
store, corner store and bakery in Chicago.
Therefore this mapping uses a two-tier rule over TWO RAW FIELDS OF THE SAME PUBLIC
RECORD (license_description, business_activity). Nothing is inferred from outside the
record. Every rule is an EXACT string match against a value observed in the source.
WHY EXACT MATCH AND NOT SUBSTRING/REGEX:
Substring matching produced false positives on real values in this dataset:
'Provide 4 or More Parking Spaces...'      contains 'spa'      -> wrong personal_services
'Live Theatrical / Live Cultural...'       contains 'theatric' -> wrong medical (therapy)
'Employee of a Wrecking/Demolition/        contains 'fitness'  -> wrong gym_fitness
Fireworks Contractor (Cert. of Fitness)'
Exact token allowlists are used everywhere. Anything not on an allowlist falls through
to 'other'. Unmatched is NEVER guessed.
MULTI-VALUED ACTIVITY: business_activity may hold several activities separated by '|'.
The string is split on '|', each part trimmed, and each part matched exactly. When
parts resolve to different categories, category_precedence below decides, most
specific first. retail_general is last because it is the weakest signal (e.g.
'Hair Services | Retail Sales of General Merchandise' is a salon, not a store).
_grocery_definition: grocery MEANS FRESH/PERISHABLE FOOD RETAIL. It is deliberately NOT 'any store
v1.0.0 of this mapping put 'Retail Sales of General Merchandise and Non-Perishable
Food' into grocery. Measured effect: 2,134 geocoded rows - 32% of the grocery
bucket - were variety stores, dollar stores and corner stores carrying NO
perishable goods. On a food-access read of the South and West sides that would
have overstated fresh-food availability by a third. Those rows now resolve to
A row carrying BOTH a perishable token and the non-perishable token is grocery:
perishable presence is the deciding signal.

source.publisher: City of Chicago, Department of Business Affairs & Consumer Protection

tier1_license_description_exact._note: Applied first. These license_description values are themselves sector-specific, so business_activity is not consulted. Liquor licenses are separate license rows from the food license of the same venue.

tier2_food_split._note: Applied ONLY to license_description == 'Retail Food Establishment'. Ordered: first matching step wins. Rationale for the order is in _order_rationale.
_order_rationale: Step A first: on-premises SEATING / on-premises consumption is the strongest and least ambiguous restaurant signal.
Step B second: a site retailing PERISHABLE food with no seating is a grocery, even if it also prepares food (e.g. a deli counter).
Step C third: remaining prepared-food-without-seating sites are takeout/quick-service/coffee, which are restaurant_cafe.
Step D fourth: a food-licensed site whose ONLY retail token is general merchandise + NON-perishable food is a variety/corner store, not a grocery. See _grocery_definition.
Step E: a Retail Food Establishment matching none of the above is NOT guessed - it goes to other.

explicit_exclusions._note: Values deliberately NOT mapped to a named bucket. Each falls to 'other' with a stated reason. Recorded here so the omission is reviewable and is never mistaken for an oversight or a zero.
explicit_exclusions.Markets / Promotes Pharmaceuticals to He: 860 rows. This is a pharmaceutical SALES REPRESENTATIVE registration, not a health care site. Mapping it to medical_health would fabricate ~860 phantom clinics, many registered to downtown offices or out-of-state HQ addresses.
explicit_exclusions.Operate a Veterinary Hospital: 117 rows. Animal health, not human medical_health. No animal-care bucket exists in this taxonomy.
explicit_exclusions.Provide Non-Invasive Cupping Therapy: 36 rows. Ambiguous between medical_health and personal_services; not asserted either way.
explicit_exclusions.Training in The Arts of Combat and Self-: 113 rows across variants. This single license value bundles martial arts WITH music and art instruction, so it cannot be resolved to gym_fitness without guessing which one the site actually does. The combat/self-defense-ONLY and gymnastics-ONLY variants ARE mapped to gym_fitness.
explicit_exclusions.Shared Kitchen User (Long Term) / (Short: 938 rows. Per spec, shared kitchen is excluded from grocery. These are food entrepreneurs REGISTERED AT a shared commissary address; the address is not their own storefront, so plotting them as retail food sites would misrepresent the geography.
explicit_exclusions.Mobile Food License / Mobile Food Prepar: 190+ rows. A mobile food license address is the commissary or business office of record, NOT where the truck operates. Plotting it as a site of activity would be a false location claim.
explicit_exclusions.Special Event Food / 180 Day Multiple Ev: 246 rows. Temporary event permits, not permanent sites.
explicit_exclusions.Wholesale Food Establishment: 399 rows. Wholesale, not retail food; no wholesale bucket exists.
explicit_exclusions.Peddler License / Street Performer / Com: 1,485+ rows. Licensed to move along the public way; there is no fixed site.
explicit_exclusions.Motor Vehicle Services License / Commerc: 2,652 rows. Automotive services and fuel retail. This taxonomy has NO automotive or fuel bucket, so these are left in 'other' rather than forced into retail_general.
explicit_exclusions.Operation of an Administrative Commercia: Office and home-based registrations. Not a customer-facing site of activity, and the address is frequently residential.
explicit_exclusions.STRUCTURAL ABSENCE - clinicians: This dataset contains NO tokens for physician, dentist, clinic, optometry, chiropractic, or pharmacy-as-drugstore, because the City of Chicago does not license clinicians - Illinois IDFPR does. medical_health is therefore structurally sparse here and MUST NOT be read as a count of health care access. This is an omission with a reason, not a zero.
